name: DynamicLake
summary: macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island hub for music, notifications, calls, timers and files.
description: A macOS app that adds a Dynamic Island-style interface to the MacBook notch: music controls, calendar and weather glances, calls, message notifications, drag-and-drop actions, file management, timers and Bluetooth device alerts. Includes a Liquid Glass style, a compact miniLake mode and plugins.
contains: macOS app that adds a Dynamic Island to the MacBook notch
features: music controls, calendar and weather, calls, notifications, drag & drop, timers
extra modules: DynaMusic, DynaGlance, DynaCall, DynaDrop, DynaClip, DynaConnect, miniLake and plugins
bundles FFmpeg code (LGPLv3.0) for audio/video conversion
